name: @modguard/desktop
description: Check a game mod before you install it — reads the mod, never runs it.
author: ModGuard
//: Everything is bundled into dist/ by Vite and esbuild, so the packaged app ships no node_modules at all — which is why nothing here is a runtime dependency.
//electron-updater: The one dependency this app has ever added for a reason other than building it. A security tool that cannot ship a fix to the people already running it is worse than one that can: until this, a fixed false positive or a new detection reached only people who happened to visit the site again. It is a devDependency like everything else because scripts/build.mjs marks only `electron` external, so esbuild inlines it into dist/main/main.cjs and the packaged app still carries no node_modules. Pinned at or above 6.3.9: CVE-2024-39698 (GHSA-9jxc-qjr9-vjxq) made the Windows updater verify a *different* file than the one it installed, and that fix landed in 6.3.0-alpha.6.
